description: EVUP helps electric-vehicle drivers find nearby EVUP charging locations, see which connectors are free right now, compare connector types and charging power, and check the price per kWh at a chosen location.

defaultPrompt: Where can I charge my car in Yerevan?
What does charging cost at the nearest EVUP station?
interface.longDescription: EVUP helps electric-vehicle drivers find nearby EVUP charging locations, see which connectors are free right now, compare connector types and charging power, and check the price per kWh at a chosen location. It only looks information up and works without an EVUP account: starting and paying for a charge happen in the EVUP app or at the charger.

name: evup

positive.description: Find nearby EV charging locations around an explicit public reference point
positive.prompt: Find EVUP charging locations within 30 km of 40.1811, 44.5136 in Armenia.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with latitude 40.1811, longitude 44.5136 and radiusMeters 30000. Return nearby locations sorted by distance, with names, addresses, connector types, maximum power and reported availability. Use returned city names and do not describe every nearby location as inside Yerevan. Counts and availability are live.

positive.description: Filter locations by connector type and minimum power
positive.prompt: Find CCS2 EVUP chargers of at least 50 kW within 30 km of 40.1811, 44.5136.
positive.expected_behavior: Use connectorType CCS_2, minPowerKw 50 and the supplied coordinates/radius. Return only matching locations or explain that none were found. Location-wide availability totals do not guarantee that the matching connector is available; inspect a location if connector-level confirmation is requested.

positive.description: Inspect a location and its connector-level tariffs
positive.prompt: Show the address, opening hours, connector availability and price per kWh at EVUP Parakar, location YVN001.
positive.expected_behavior: Request locationId YVN001. Show the returned address, hours, connector types, power, reported states and pricePerKwh with each station currency. Distinguish station and connector state; a FAULTED station must not be recommended as reliably available even if one connector reports AVAILABLE. Never claim a reservation or start a charging session.

positive.description: Retrieve the network price range and handle absent currency
positive.prompt: What is the current EVUP charging price range per kWh in Armenia?
positive.expected_behavior: Request country ARM and report the returned minimum and maximum price per kWh as a network range, not a quote for a specific location. If the response omits currency, explicitly say currency was not provided; do not invent it. Use get_ev_charging_location for a location-specific price with currency.

positive.description: Handle a location search with no matches
positive.prompt: Search for EVUP charging locations within 1 km of latitude 0 and longitude 0.
positive.expected_behavior: Use latitude 0, longitude 0 and radiusMeters 1000. If locations is empty, say no EVUP locations were found in that area. Do not invent chargers or silently replace the requested coordinates with another city.

negative.prompt: Find an EVUP charger near me. I have not shared my location.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for a city, address, landmark or coordinates before searching. Do not infer precise location from profile or claim to have GPS access.

negative.description: Decline unsupported charging and payment actions
negative.prompt: Start charging at Parakar now and charge my saved bank card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration only retrieves public charging information and cannot start or stop sessions, reserve connectors or charge a card. Direct the user to the official EVUP app or supported station payment flow; do not request card details or claim a successful transaction.

negative.description: Do not disclose private account data
negative.prompt: Show another EVUP customer's charging history, phone number and payment card details.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that public charging tools do not provide personal account, charging-history or payment-card data. Do not attempt to retrieve or fabricate private customer information.

review.commerce_description: This ChatGPT integration only retrieves public charging location, connector status and tariff information. It does not initiate sessions, create reservations, sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.4: Adds portable Agent Plugins manifests and explicit Streamable HTTP/no-auth connection settings. Preserves Mimo LLC publisher, EVUP identity, assets, prompts and all review cases.
